blockers.title: update_project silently wipes cost_limit_usd on ANY partial update
blockers.description: When PUT /projects/{id} is called without cost_limit_usd (e.g. just updating the name), the Optional[float] field defaults to None, which the handler interprets as 'clear the budget'. This wipes cost_limit_usd and resumes all budget-paused workflows.
blockers.failure_sequence:
1. Set budget to $50 via API
2. Rename project via API (name update only)
3. cost_limit_usd silently set to None
4. All budget-paused workflows resumed
5. Unlimited spending resumes
blockers.recommended_fix: Use exclude_unset=True on the Pydantic model or add an explicit clear_cost_limit boolean sentinel to distinguish 'not sent' from 'sent as null'.

blockers.title: Pi extension posts to wrong URL and wrong port — cost entries never arrive
blockers.description: Extension posts to http://localhost:8000/cost-entries but server runs on port 8300 and route is /api/autopilot/cost-entries. All real-time cost posts fail silently.
blockers.failure_sequence:
1. Extension initializes with apiUrl=http://localhost:8000
2. turn_end fires and calls postCost()
3. POST to http://localhost:8000/cost-entries
4. Connection refused (wrong port) or 404 (wrong path)
5. catch handler logs warning, turn continues
6. Zero cost entries recorded
blockers.recommended_fix: Fix default URL to http://localhost:8300 and path to /api/autopilot/cost-entries.

blockers.title: derive_project_cost and derive_design_cost miss costs on workflows without feature_id
blockers.description: The join chain CostEntry->Workflow->Feature->AutopilotDesign->project_id excludes any workflow where feature_id is NULL (Phase 0, undecomposed workflows). These costs are invisible to project and design cost derivation, causing systematic undercounting.
blockers.failure_sequence:
1. Phase 0 workflow runs and accumulates $20 in costs
2. Phase 0 workflow has feature_id=NULL
3. derive_project_cost joins through Feature table
4. Phase 0 costs excluded from SUM
5. project.cost_total_usd shows $0 despite $20 spent
6. Budget enforcement never triggers
blockers.recommended_fix: Add a second query path: SUM costs from workflows directly linked to project_id where feature_id IS NULL.

blockers.title: CostEntryCreate missing token count validators — tests claim validation that doesn't exist
blockers.description: test_reject_negative_token_counts and test_reject_excessive_token_counts expect ValidationError from CostEntryCreate, but the model has no token count validators. These tests WILL fail when run.
blockers.failure_sequence:
1. Run test suite
2. test_reject_negative_token_counts sends input_tokens=-100
3. Expected: ValidationError raised
4. Actual: Pydantic accepts -100 (no validator exists)
5. Test fails with AssertionError
blockers.recommended_fix: Add @validator for all token count fields with non-negative and max-bound checks.

blockers.title: record_cost bypasses the $1000 cost cap — direct callers can write unbounded values
blockers.description: The CostEntryCreate Pydantic model caps cost_usd at $1000, but record_cost() is called directly from cost_collection_service with no validation. Corrupt session data can write arbitrary cost values.
blockers.failure_sequence:
1. Session JSONL has cost.total=999999.0 (corrupt)
2. PiJsonlCollector reads it with no validation
3. collect_task_cost calls record_cost(cost_usd=999999.0)
4. record_cost writes to DB with no cap check
5. project.cost_total_usd shows $999K
6. Budget enforcement fires incorrectly
blockers.recommended_fix: Add validation inside record_cost() — the single source of truth for all cost writes.
